newsitem.title: UK: DB Capital Markets sets interest rate warrants.
newsitem.headline: DB Capital Markets sets interest rate warrants.

text.p: DB Capital Markets has issued eight million American-style call and put warrants, in eight equal tranches, on three Bunds, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
